speckit.name: Full SDD Cycle
speckit.description: Runs specify → plan → tasks → implement with review gates

adr-create.name: ADR Creation with Review
adr-create.description: Create a single ADR via proposal → specs → design → adr → tasks → implement → converge

adr-ci.name: ADR CI Gate
adr-ci.description: Validate ADR corpus in CI — no human checkpoints, exit codes only

adr-batch.name: Batch ADR Creation
adr-batch.description: Create multiple ADRs in sequence with validation after each

openspec-change.name: OpenSpec Change Workflow
openspec-change.description: Full OpenSpec change workflow: proposal → specs → design → adr → tasks → implement → converge. Creates artifacts in openspec/changes/ and registers as a spec-kit issue.

engineering-sdd.name: Engineering SDD
engineering-sdd.description: Spec-driven workflow for internal engineering changes the user never sees: state machines, concurrency, lifecycle, sync/queue correctness, diagnostics and debugging. Explore → specify → model → verification design → gate → plan → gate → tasks → optional implement → verify → converge. Artifacts live in openspec/changes/<slug>/.
